summary: PLAT-103: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty (shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0, breaking). Billing (payments), reports (insights) and core-shell (platform) pass owner matching package.json team. Single PR #1, CI+CD green. Assumptions: libs/ is inlined at build time, so no registry publish or lockfile update applies; owner is hardcoded since the browser bundle can't read package.json; core-shell also called validateApp (not in sub-tasks) so I fixed it to avoid breaking it. CD doesn't build/deploy reports (only shell+billing), so reports isn't deployed by the pipeline.
